name: Amartha 10X Run
short_description: A verified half-marathon event in Senayan, Jakarta, Indonesia, offering 21.1km and 10km distances on September 6, 2026, with registration open from IDR 450,000.
ai_summary: The Amartha 10X Run is a half-marathon event taking place on September 6, 2026 at Plaza Parkir Timur GBK, Senayan, in Jakarta, Indonesia. Runners can choose between a 21.1km half-marathon or a 10km distance. Registration is currently open, with prices starting from IDR 450,000. This event is verified for the directory.
pros: Registration is currently open, giving runners ample time to plan
Offers two distance options (21.1km and 10km) to suit different runner levels
Held at a well-known venue, Plaza Parkir Timur GBK, Senayan
Verified listing, adding a layer of credibility to the event details
cons: No further details are available on course terrain, elevation, or amenities
Pricing is listed only as a starting point, with no full breakdown of registration tiers
research_highlights: The 2026 edition (3rd edition) takes place Sunday, September 6, 2026, starting and finishing at Plaza Timur/Plaza Barat Gelora Bung Karno (GBK), Senayan, with categories 10K and Half Marathon.
Cut-off times are set at 2 hours for the 10K and 4 hours for the Half Marathon.
The half marathon route extends beyond Sudirman/Bundaran HI into Senopati, Prapanca, and Blok M before returning to the finish, while the 10K stays within the GBK–Sudirman–Bundaran HI corridor.
Water stations for half marathon runners are placed every 2 kilometers, and the race area is kept separate from the regular Car Free Day activity in the GBK area.
Start time for the 2026 race is 05:00 WIB, and the event includes a themed 'Race Village' with rural-market/UMKM booths, traditional games, and local produce for participants to explore post-race.
research_watchouts: Available research consists almost entirely of official press releases and organizer/sponsor statements (Amartha, race director Satrio Guardian, SVP Sheldon Chuan) rather than independent participant race reports, so on-the-ground runner feedback (heat, crowding, logistics complaints) could not be verified.
No participant reviews, forum discussions, or Strava/community race reports discussing course conditions, heat, or organizational issues were found for this event at the time of research.
